configValues.name: province_starting_population
configValues.description: The starting population of all provinces at the start of the game. (int, default=20000)

configValues.name: province_starting_population_variance
configValues.description: The lower and upper bounds of a multiplier applied to each provinces starting population. A value of 0.2 means there will be a between 20% more or 20% less population in that province. Set to 0 to disable random population. (float, default = 0.15)

configValues.name: starting_nations_world_percentage
configValues.description: What percentage of the starting provinces have an AI nation assigned to them. Set to 0 to disable AI nations at server start. (float, default = 0.333)

configValues.name: do_allow_ai_nation_spawn_at_border
configValues.description: Whether AI nations are allowed to spawn bordering existing nations. 'false' prevents it from happening. 'avoid' will prevent it from happening as long as there is room. 'true' will allow it entirely. (default = 'avoid')
